about: A glass-heavy window for perf.py's measure of Reduce transparency (docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx, docs/performance.mdx): sample/MaterialProbe.tsx's blur views over their targets and the lock screen's clock in its material, the clock moved on a minute so its last digit turns over several frames, each drawn again, Reduce transparency off: each frame blurs the clock's target under its glyphs.

steps.name: the clock moved on a minute: its last digit turns over several frames, each drawn again
